title: Adventure
notes: Measured supplied NTSC ROM. Dedicated read-only interpretation separates visible room walls, castle masses, the player, gates, standing dragons/bat/items and a raised bridge using the user's own cartridge graphics and RAM. Only recently observed unchanged sprites are held for up to three multiplexed frames. Dark walls remain hidden. Overlaps, all game variations and complete gameplay still need physical iPhone coverage; experimental, not full support. Adventure itself is single-player.
